【原视频简介】
I spent 1 year growing this copper acetate crystal from copper metal and vinegar.

Copper acetate crystals grow much slower compared to many other crystals, due to its low solubility in water. The process took me 1 year and 19 days in total. But the patience is definitely worth it!

For a detailed written guide on making this work, check out my son's blog post at https://crystalverse.com/copper-acetate-crystals

Do note that copper acetate is mildly toxic. Either wash your hands after touching it, or wear gloves when handling. Keep away from children and food.

For family friendly crystals, check out my other vids.

---

MATERIALS

I bought my materials in Malaysia, but the items below are similar ones available on Amazon — they work just as well if you’d like to try this experiment yourself.

• Copper chops (so you don't have to cut them): https://amzn.to/4qVLzO9
• Vinegar (more concentrated version): https://amzn.to/4hRokAG
• Hydrogen peroxide: https://amzn.to/47zghFg
• Nylon fishing line (clear, 0.14 mm): https://amzn.to/3LvU9mF
• 250 mL beaker: https://amzn.to/49P4mob
• 600 mL beaker: https://amzn.to/445FbKh
• Large flat dish: https://amzn.to/43sxb5T
• Plastic petri dish (90 × 15 mm): https://amzn.to/43YeDdX
• Plastic funnel: https://amzn.to/4oEcbll
• Filter paper: https://amzn.to/4oAKD01
• Precision tweezers: https://amzn.to/3JIbpoa
• Digital scale: https://amzn.to/4olYTsy
